mapper.select: SELECT s.scenario_no, s.category_no, c.name AS category_name, s.title, s.description, s.status, s.sort_order, s.active_version_no, s.frst_reg_dt, s.lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario s JOIN tb_scenario_category c ON c.scenario_category_no = s.category_no WHERE s.scenario_no = #{id}

SELECT s.scenario_no, s.category_no, c.name AS category_name, s.title, s.description, s.status, s.sort_order, s.active_version_no, s.frst_reg_dt, s.lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario s JOIN tb_scenario_category c ON c.scenario_category_no = s.category_no WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_no IS NOT NULL AND c.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(s.sort_order, 0), s.scenario_no) DESC, s.scenario_no DESC

SELECT s.scenario_no, s.category_no, c.name AS category_name, s.title, s.description, s.status, s.sort_order, s.active_version_no, s.frst_reg_dt, s.lst_chg_dt FROM tb_scenario s JOIN tb_scenario_category c ON c.scenario_category_no = s.category_no WHERE s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.active_version_no IS NOT NULL AND c.use_yn = 'Y' AND ( lower(s.title) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' OR lower(COALESCE(s.description, '')) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_scenario_node n WHERE n.version_no = s.active_version_no AND ( lower(COALESCE(n.title, '')) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' OR lower(COALESCE(n.content, '')) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_scenario_node_option o JOIN tb_scenario_node n ON n.scenario_node_no = o.node_no WHERE n.version_no = s.active_version_no AND o.use_yn = 'Y' AND lower(o.label) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_scenario_keyword k WHERE k.scenario_no = s.scenario_no AND k.use_yn = 'Y' AND lower(k.keyword) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_scenario_keyword k JOIN tb_scenario_synonym sy ON sy.keyword_no = k.scenario_keyword_no WHERE k.scenario_no = s.scenario_no AND k.use_yn = 'Y' AND sy.use_yn = 'Y' AND lower(sy.synonym) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN lower(s.title) LIKE '%' || lower(#{query}) || '%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.sort_order, 0), s.scenario_no) DESC, s.scenario_no DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_scenario (category_no, title, description, status, sort_order) VALUES (#{categoryNo}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_scenario SET category_no = #{categoryNo}, title = #{title}, description = #{description}, sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE scenario_no = #{scenarioNo}
UPDATE tb_scenario SET status = #{status}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE scenario_no = #{id}
UPDATE tb_scenario SET sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE scenario_no = #{id} AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE tb_scenario SET status = 'ACTIVE', active_version_no = #{activeVersionId}, lst_chg_dt = now() WHERE scenario_no = #{id}
